debit.notes: 24x7 (ICICI NRI customer care advertised 24/7). Lost/stolen debit card: 'Block the Card immediately via iMobile, Net Banking or by calling Customer Care on 1800 1080.' iMobile path: Debit card > Card block; Internet Banking path: Customer Services > Service Requests > Bank Accounts > More > 'Block Debit / ATM Card'. number1 is the line for domestic customers travelling overseas; number2 is the NRI global number (non-toll-free), with NRI India toll-free 1800 102 5600. Fraud: ICICI helpline 1800 2662; national cybercrime helpline 1930 (both on ICICI pages). No SMS block keyword published; email is the general customer-care address.

credit.notes: 24x7 (ICICI NRI customer care advertised 24/7). Report promptly and the bank blocks/hotlists the credit card; iMobile path: Debit card > Card block > select card type 'Credit Card'; Internet Banking path: Customer Services > Service Requests > Credit Card > More > 'Block Credit Card'. number1 is the line for domestic customers travelling overseas; number2 is the NRI global number (non-toll-free), with NRI India toll-free 1800 102 5600. Fraud: ICICI helpline 1800 2662; national cybercrime helpline 1930 (both on ICICI pages). No SMS block keyword published; email is the general customer-care address.

upi.notes: Freeze UPI in the iMobile app: go to 'UPI Payments', click 'My UPI ID'; to delink a bank account click the account and click 'Delink' in the 'Account details' page, or to remove a UPI ID/number click the UPI number and click the 'Remove' button (a removed UPI number can be reclaimed within 6 months). Fraudulent transaction: 'Call 1800 1080 immediately' (toll-free 1800 1080; overseas +91-22-33667777; fraud helpline 1800 2662). Entering the wrong UPI PIN three consecutive times blocks the account for the next 24 hours for debit UPI transactions. No netbanking UPI-manage path, SMS keyword or *99# channel is published; ICICI's UPI terms reserve the bank's right to suspend the UPI facility.
